name: embed
description: Small models and what it costs to shrink them. Builds two tiny ONNX models on the spot — a hashing bag-of-words embedder and a sentiment classifier trained here in numpy — reads and writes .onnx from raw protobuf with no onnx package, runs the graphs in a 200-line numpy interpreter, and compresses the weights to float16, int8 (per-tensor and per-channel) and 4 bits. Every compression is scored twice: the error it put into the weights, and what it did to the model's actual answers, including the share of answers that changed while accuracy stayed still. The compressed files are ordinary ONNX — DequantizeLinear and Cast nodes, nothing invented here — and when onnxruntime is installed the module runs every file through it as an independent check that its own protobuf writer and interpreter are right.
frontend: src/app.py (stdlib — the console at /embed on :50621; proxies /embed/_api)
state: ~/.mod/embed/models — built models and the ledger of what they were built from; nothing else is kept

models.bow-64: hashing bag-of-words → 64-d random projection, built from a seed, 2.0 MB
models.sent-mlp: 4096-bucket bag → 64 hidden → 2 classes, trained here in ~2s, 1.0 MB
models.minilm: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 ONNX, ~90 MB, downloaded on request

methods.float32: the baseline — no change, so the table has a control row
methods.float16: half the bytes, ~0.02% weight error, no answer changed on either model
methods.int8: a quarter of the bytes via DequantizeLinear, ~1% weight error, no answer changed
methods.int8-per-channel: one scale per channel — half the error of int8, and larger than it on bow-64
methods.int4-sim: four bits in an int8 container (ONNX has no 4-bit tensor before opset 21) — measures the accuracy of 4 bits, not the size

measures.rel_rmse: per-tensor error relative to the weights' own magnitude
measures.task: retrieval top-1 for the embedder, held-out accuracy for the classifier
measures.agreement_with_float: share of answers identical to the float32 model's — the strict metric, and the one that moves first

env.EMBED_API: where the console proxies to (default http://127.0.0.1:50620)

toolchain.optional: onnxruntime — only to cross-check this module's own runtime and files; nothing imports it otherwise
